room_rent.note: If higher room taken, all associated expenses reimbursed proportionately. Pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics excluded from proportionate deduction.

icu.note: Includes ICU bed, monitoring, critical care nursing and intensivist charges.

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons regardless of age.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower. Modern/advanced treatments (robotic surgery, etc.): up to 50% of SI.

initial_waiting.note: Does not apply to accidents or if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: Policy wording states 36 months under standard exclusion clause, but Table of Benefits states 4 years (48 months) for declared PEDs. The longer period (48 months) is used as the operative term per the table.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, varicose veins, hysterectomy, etc. 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of SI added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made. Max 50% of SI.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy.

pre_hosp.note: Expenses for the same condition for which hospitalisation was required.

post_hosp.note: Expenses for the same condition following admissible hospitalisation.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour hospitalisation requirement waived for day-care.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation/OPD treatment explicitly excluded under specific exclusions.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals meeting NABH/NQAS criteria.

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI.

consumables.note: Consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) explicitly listed under non-payable items in Annexure B List I.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly premium mode; 15 days for monthly instalment mode. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; continuity credits for waiting periods transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary/OPD, overseas treatment, war, nuclear/bio/chemical attack, specific ICD codes for declared diseases

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons mentioned in the policy wording.
